title: Obligation: Must and Have To
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Ahora puedes expresar obligaciones y necesidades en el trabajo usando 'must' y 'have to'.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Must y Have To

parts.visual: Must y Have to se usan para expresar obligación (deber / tener que). I must finish this today (Debo terminar esto hoy). You have to wear a badge (Tienes que usar una credencial).
parts.audio: Must and Have to are used to express obligation. I must finish this today. You have to wear a badge.

parts.visual: Must es más personal o formal. Have to es más común para reglas externas. En A1, ambos significan lo mismo. Ojo con he/she/it: He has to go (Él tiene que ir).
parts.audio: Must is more personal or formal. Have to is more common for external rules. In level A1, they mean the same thing. Be careful with he, she, it: He has to go.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de obligación.

questions.question: You ____ to wear a badge in the building. (Tienes que).
She ____ to attend the meeting. (Tiene que).
They ____ to sign the contract. (Tienen que).
He ____ pass the security check. (Debe).
questions.explanation: He + must (must no cambia con he/she/it).

questions.question: Do I ____ to pay now? (¿Tengo que?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta con do: Do I have to...?

questions.question: Does she ____ to work on Saturday? (¿Tiene que?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta con does: Does she have to...?

questions.question: I ____ to leave early today. (Tengo que).
We ____ to inform the client immediately. (Tenemos que).
____ I have to sign this? (¿Tengo que...?).
She ____ to travel next week. (Tiene que).
They must ____ the project by Friday. (Completar).
We don't ____ to wear a suit. (No tenemos que / No es necesario).
questions.explanation: Don't have to = no es necesario/obligatorio.

questions.question: Does he ____ to send the email? (¿Tiene que?).
I ____ talk to the manager. It's urgent. (Debo).
We don't ____ to wear a suit. (Tenemos).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension

She must finish the report today.
I have to finish the report today.
I must send the report today.
